rules.statement: An option to obtain a retransfer of land on the payment of a certain sum passes to heirs and is enforceable, even if no time limit is specified in the agreement.
rules.supporting_quote: The remedy of the vendor on such an agreement is dealt with, and it is stated that his right passes to his heirs and is also assignable. Van Leeuwen (Censura Forensis, Pt. I., bk. IV., ch. 20) is to the same effect.
